evidence.claim: Emmanuel Ramambason is ISDA Board Member and Global co-Head of Credit Portfolio Management at Standard Chartered, serving as Financial Markets Head of Standard Chartered Bank AG
evidence.excerpt: Emmanuel Ramambason is an ISDA Board Member and the Global co-Head of Credit Portfolio Management at Standard Chartered. He serves as the Global Head of Resource Management and Optimization (RMO), Financial Markets, at Standard Chartered Bank.
evidence.notes: ISDA Board membership provides direct governance involvement in derivatives standardization.

evidence.claim: Standard Chartered is contributing to the development of ISDA Digital Regulatory Reporting (DRR), alongside BNP Paribas, Pictet Group, and JPMorgan
evidence.excerpt: Financial institutions such as BNP Paribas, Pictet Group, Standard Chartered, and JPMorgan are contributing to the development of DRR.
evidence.notes: Active DRR contribution places Standard Chartered among leading CDM adopters.

evidence.claim: Standard Chartered has supported the development of FINOS open source projects including CDM and Rune DSL for regulatory reporting
evidence.excerpt: Several leading financial entities, including BNP Paribas, J.P. Morgan Chase, and Standard Chartered, have supported the development of these open-source projects - specifically relating to the Common Domain Model (CDM) and Rune DSL initiatives.
evidence.notes: Support for both CDM and Rune DSL indicates deep engagement with regulatory reporting infrastructure.

evidence.claim: Ewen Crawford, Senior Product Owner at Standard Chartered Bank, participated in expert panel on CFTC and EMIR reporting rewrites, demonstrating internal regulatory reporting expertise
evidence.excerpt: Ewen Crawford, Senior Product Owner at Standard Chartered Bank, highlighted that the process flow structure creates problems, noting the decade old GTR engine implemented for global firms.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates internal regulatory reporting expertise and engagement with industry discussions.

null_searches.implication: No confirmed production usage, but active contribution established

classification.rationale: Strong evidence of CDM/DRR ecosystem contribution: ISDA Board member, active DRR contributor alongside BNP/JPMorgan/Pictet, FINOS CDM/Rune DSL supporter. Not ARCHITECT-Native due to no production announcement, but clearly ARCHITECT-Follower based on contribution activity.
